title: Michael Howell: The Global Money Pool is Drying Up

excerpts.label: Money moves markets — the master framework
excerpts.insight: Howell explains why global liquidity is the primary driver of everything: economics is downstream of markets, geopolitics is downstream of economics, so money flows are the root signal to watch
excerpts.pm_takeaway: MONITOR global liquidity as your leading indicator — before earnings, before rates, before geopolitics. If liquidity turns down, reduce risk regardless of other signals.

excerpts.label: 80% of markets are debt refinancing — the structural reframe
excerpts.insight: Modern financial markets are not capital-raising venues. ~80% of all primary financial transactions are debt rollovers. Debt refinancing swamps new capital investment 4-to-1. Financial crises occur when debt exceeds refinancing capacity
excerpts.pm_takeaway: REFRAME your market model: markets exist primarily to roll over debt, not raise new capital. Any analysis that ignores refinancing cycles is missing the primary driver of market structure and crisis risk.

excerpts.label: Oil price: small GDP hit, massive liquidity drain
excerpts.insight: Iran war oil premium (~$40/bbl) has only cut 0.5–0.75% of world GDP — modest. But every $10 oil increase cuts ~3% from global liquidity. The financial market impact is disproportionately larger than the economic impact
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE the 'oil = GDP hit' narrative. Oil's primary damage is liquidity, not growth. $40 oil premium = ~12% global liquidity drain. Long oil hedges, but that money is NOT available for equities or treasuries — reduce financial asset exposure accordingly.

excerpts.label: MOVE index + collateral multiplier + dollar: three simultaneous drains
excerpts.insight: Three transmission channels are draining liquidity simultaneously: (1) MOVE index spike — 10pt increase = -4% global liquidity via repo haircuts on Treasury collateral; (2) 80% of lending is collateral-based so volatility shrinks borrowing capacity; (3) dollar +3–5% since Iran crisis = -3–5% global liquidity (1-for-1 relationship)
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH MOVE index as a liquidity leading indicator. MOVE > 130 is a flashing red — repo haircuts widen, global credit contracts. Short credit / reduce risk. Dollar strength = additional liquidity headwind for EM and dollar borrowers globally. These three channels are compounding right now.

excerpts.label: The COVID debt maturity wall arrives 2026–2030
excerpts.insight: COVID-era zero-rate borrowers extended debt maturities, creating a bulge of refinancing due 2026–2030 at higher rates and against thinner bank balance sheets. This is the slow-motion structural threat
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SIZE UP crisis hedges for 2026–2029. COVID zero-rate debt matures into a high-rate environment with reduced bank balance sheet capacity. This is structural, not cyclical. Repo stress episodes will intensify. Own gold, bonds, and SOFR hedges before the wall hits in volume.

excerpts.label: Fed's stealth QE: RMP is QE — $200B already added
excerpts.insight: Late-2025 SOFR spread spike forced the Fed to restart QE under the label 'Reserve Management Purchases' (RMP). Despite official QT narrative, the Fed balance sheet has expanded ~$200B since start of 2026. No evidence of QT — balance sheet is clearly expanding
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY risk assets on any Fed balance sheet expansion — RMP is QE regardless of label. Fed balance sheet at ~$200B expansion YTD. Next SOFR spike will force a larger RMP. Front-run the Fed: own bonds and gold before the next crisis forces their hand.

excerpts.label: Yield curve: consensus was wrong — bear flattening playing out
excerpts.insight: Consensus entered 2026 positioned for bear steepening (long-end rising faster). Howell's model called bear flattening, transitioning to bull flattening. The flattening is happening now. Cause: liquidity cycle turning down, not policy tightening — driven by real-economy demand for capital (AI capex, working capital, oil costs)
excerpts.pm_takeaway: RECEIVE 2s10s (flatteners). Consensus bear steepener unwind is in progress. Howell called this before it happened. Next phase: bull flattening — buy duration, add 10Y+ Treasuries. The liquidity cycle governs the curve, not the Fed.

excerpts.label: T-bill monetization: banks buying short debt = monetary inflation = gold
excerpts.insight: Bessent (like Yellen) is issuing massive T-bill volume. Banks absorb T-bills = textbook monetization. US M2 hit all-time high. Banks' Treasury holdings grow 2–3 ppts/year faster than M2. Government spending is the biggest driver of money supply. This is monetary inflation — the mechanical reason gold is surging
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG GOLD — this is not a narrative trade. T-bill issuance absorbed by banks = monetization by definition. M2 all-time high. Banks' Treasury holdings outpacing M2 by 2–3 ppts/yr = inflation embedded in the banking system. Gold is the cleanest hedge. This dynamic persists as long as deficits are T-bill funded.
